question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
-- Final answer: difference between avg of highest-count month and avg of lowest-count month
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) - 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date::DATE >= '2020-01-01' AND txn_date::DATE <= '2020-12-31'
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
positive_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_balance_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_balance_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_count DESC) as rank_high,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_count ASC) as rank_low
    FROM positive_counts
),
top_months AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT month FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_high = 1) as highest_month,
        (SELECT month FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_low = 1) as lowest_month
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.highest_month,
        tm.lowest_month,
        (SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) FROM monthly_balances WHERE month = (SELECT highest_month FROM top_months)) as avg_highest_month,
        (SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) FROM monthly_balances WHERE month = (SELECT lowest_month FROM top_months)) as avg_lowest_month
    FROM top_months tm
)
SELECT 
    avg_highest_month - avg_lowest_month as difference
FROM avg_balances
